title: Dominic and the Confession
author: Silas Sandoval
blurb: Yara Eastwick, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
